schemes.title: Odisha Income Certificate
schemes.department: Revenue & Disaster Management Department, Government of Odisha
schemes.brief: The certificate from the Tahasildar that states your family's yearly income. Almost every scholarship, fee concession, hostel seat and welfare scheme asks for it. Apply on Odisha One, the state's single citizen portal, which has taken over the old e-District counter for this service. If you cannot fill it yourself, the operator at any Mo Seva Kendra or CSC will do it for you. The Revenue Inspector of your tahasil verifies the income before the Tahasildar signs.
schemes.benefit: Income certificate signed digitally by the Tahasildar, downloaded as a PDF
eligibility: You must live in Odisha and apply in the tahasil where you actually live
The certificate is issued for the whole family's yearly income from every source, not for one person's salary
The applicant must be 18 or above; for a student under 18 the parent or guardian applies
An Aadhaar number and a mobile number that can receive an OTP are needed to register on the portal
The income you write must match what the Revenue Inspector finds on enquiry, or the application is rejected
documents: Aadhaar card of the applicant
Residence proof with the Odisha address - electricity bill, voter ID or ration card
Passport photograph of the applicant
Salary slip or the employer's certificate, if anyone in the family is in service
Land record (RoR) from Bhulekh, if the family income comes from farming
Ration card, where the family holds one

demoFields.label: Applicant's Name
demoFields.hint: Write it exactly as it is spelt on your Aadhaar card. The certificate is printed with this spelling and cannot be corrected later without a fresh application.

demoFields.label: Father's / Husband's Name
demoFields.hint: Your father's name, or your husband's name if you are married and want the certificate in your married name.

demoFields.label: Date of Birth
demoFields.hint: As printed on your Aadhaar or your matriculation certificate.

demoFields.label: Gender
demoFields.hint: Pick from the drop-down.

demoFields.label: Aadhaar Number
demoFields.hint: Your own 12 digits. An OTP goes to the mobile number linked to this Aadhaar, so carry that phone.

demoFields.label: Mobile Number
demoFields.hint: A number you actually carry. The acknowledgement and the download link arrive here by SMS.

demoFields.label: Present Address - District / Tahasil / Block / Gram Panchayat / Village / PIN
demoFields.hint: Pick each one from the drop-downs. Choose the tahasil you really live in - the Revenue Inspector of that tahasil is the person who comes to enquire.

demoFields.label: Annual Family Income (Rs.)
demoFields.hint: Add up what every earning member of the family makes in one year - wages, farming, shop, pension, rent. Do not write only your own income.

demoFields.label: Source of Income
demoFields.hint: Say plainly where the money comes from. If it is farming, the land record you attach should match this.

demoFields.label: Purpose of the Certificate
demoFields.hint: Write why you need it. Some offices want the purpose printed on the certificate itself.

demoSteps: Open Odisha One, register with your mobile number and the OTP, then go to Revenue & Disaster Management and choose Income Certificate. A Mo Seva Kendra or CSC operator will do this for you if you cannot.
Fill the form and upload Aadhaar, residence proof and the photograph as clear scans within the file size the page shows, then pay the fee displayed before you submit.
Write down the acknowledgement number on the receipt. It is the only way to track the case or to raise a complaint about it.
The Revenue Inspector of your tahasil verifies the income, usually by asking at your village or ward and at the Gram Panchayat.
The Tahasildar signs the certificate digitally and the status on the portal changes to approved.
Log in with the acknowledgement number and download the signed PDF. The digital signature is valid on its own - no office needs to stamp it again.
If it is rejected, the reason appears on the same status page. Correct only that point and apply again; there is no appeal fee.
schemes.helpline: Mo Seva Kendra in your block or ward, or the Tahasildar's office of your tahasil

schemes.title: Odisha Ration Card - NFSA or State Food Security Scheme
schemes.department: Food, Supplies & Consumer Welfare Department, Government of Odisha
schemes.brief: A new ration card for a family, applied for online on the PDS Odisha portal. There are two schemes: NFSA, the central food law, and SFSS, the State Food Security Scheme, which covers poor families left out of the NFSA list. The same portal is used later to add a newborn or a bride to the card, or to remove a name. The eldest woman of the family aged 18 or above is the head of the household on the card - this is fixed by law and cannot be changed to the husband's name.
schemes.benefit: 5 kg of rice per person per month; 35 kg a month for an Antyodaya (AAY) family
eligibility: The family must live in Odisha and must not hold a ration card in any other state or district
A family with a government or PSU job, an income-tax payer, or a motorised four-wheeler in the house is excluded from NFSA
A poor family left out of the NFSA list applies under the State Food Security Scheme (SFSS) instead, on the same portal
The eldest woman of the family, aged 18 or above, must be shown as the head of the household
Every member's Aadhaar has to be given, and e-KYC done at the fair price shop before grain starts
documents: Aadhaar card of every member of the family
Residence proof - electricity bill, voter ID, or a certificate from the Sarpanch or ward officer
Passport photograph of the head of the family
First page of the bank passbook of the head of the family
A mobile number linked to the head of the family's Aadhaar, for the OTP
Deletion certificate from the old card, if the family has moved in from another district or state
Caste certificate, if the family is claiming the Antyodaya (AAY) category

demoFields.label: District / Block or ULB / Gram Panchayat / Village
demoFields.hint: Pick from the drop-downs. Choose the place where the family actually lives - the block staff verify at this address.

demoFields.label: Name of the Head of the Family
demoFields.hint: The eldest woman of the family aged 18 or above. The law fixes this; do not put the husband's name here.

demoFields.label: Aadhaar Number of the Head of the Family
demoFields.hint: Her own 12 digits, spelt exactly as on the Aadhaar card.

demoFields.label: Mobile Number (linked to Aadhaar)
demoFields.hint: The OTP comes here. If her Aadhaar has no mobile linked, get it linked at an Aadhaar centre first, or do the form at a Mo Seva Kendra.

demoFields.label: Family Members - Name, Relation, Aadhaar
demoFields.value: Gopal Behera - husband - 9999 7744 3344; Lipsa Behera - daughter - 9999 7744 5566; Sanatan Behera - son - 9999 7744 7788
demoFields.hint: Add every person who eats in the house. A name left out now needs a separate member-addition application later.

demoFields.label: Annual Family Income (Rs.)
demoFields.hint: The whole family's income for one year. It decides whether you come under NFSA, under SFSS, or under neither.

demoFields.label: Scheme applied for
demoFields.hint: NFSA if the family is on the priority list, SFSS if it was left out of NFSA but is still poor. Ask at the Block office which list your family is on.

demoFields.label: Bank Account Number and IFSC of the Head
demoFields.hint: Copy both from the first page of her passbook. The account should be in her own name and Aadhaar-seeded.

demoFields.label: Fair Price Shop to draw from
demoFields.value: Sakhigopal FPS, picked from the list for the Gram Panchayat
demoFields.hint: Choose the ration shop nearest your house from the drop-down. Changing it later means a fresh application at the Block office.

demoFields.label: Old Ration Card Number, if any
demoFields.value: Blank - the family has never held a card
demoFields.hint: Leave it blank for a brand new card. If the family held a card elsewhere, write that number and attach the deletion certificate.

demoSteps: Open the NFSA new-card form on the PDS Odisha portal, or the SFSS form if your family is outside the NFSA list. Mo Seva Kendra and CSC operators fill it for you.
Enter the head of the family's Aadhaar and verify with the OTP on her Aadhaar-linked mobile, then add every member of the family with their own Aadhaar.

Upload the residence proof and the photograph, submit, and write down the Form Number printed on the acknowledgement. Every later step - tracking, adding a member, removing a member - uses this Form Number.
The Block office or the ULB verifies the household, and the Sarpanch or ward officer may be asked about your family.
Once approved, the card is printed and handed over at the Block or ULB office or at your fair price shop. Check every name, relation and Aadhaar on it before you leave.
Get each member's Aadhaar e-KYC done on the machine at the fair price shop. The family's grain does not start until this is finished.
Track the application by the Form Number on the same portal, or ring the department's toll-free helpline if it has not moved in a month.
schemes.helpline: 1800-345-6724 or 155335 (Food, Supplies & Consumer Welfare Department, Odisha)

schemes.title: Subhadra Yojana - Rs 50,000 for Women
schemes.department: Women & Child Development and Mission Shakti Department, Government of Odisha
schemes.brief: A cash payment to women of Odisha aged 21 to 60: Rs 10,000 a year for five years, Rs 50,000 in all. It comes in two instalments of Rs 5,000 each year, near Rakhi Purnima and near International Women's Day on 8 March. The money is paid straight into the woman's own bank account by DBT, so the account must be Aadhaar-seeded and DBT-enabled - an ordinary Aadhaar link is not enough. Apply on the Subhadra portal, or free of charge at any Mo Seva Kendra, Anganwadi centre or CSC.
schemes.benefit: Rs 10,000 a year for five years, paid as two instalments of Rs 5,000 - Rs 50,000 in total
eligibility: A woman living in Odisha, aged 21 to 60 on the qualifying date the government fixes for that year
The family holds an NFSA or State Food Security Scheme ration card; a woman without either can apply if the family's yearly income is Rs 2,50,000 or less
She must not be getting Rs 1,500 a month or more, or Rs 18,000 a year or more, from any other government scheme
Not an income-tax payer, and not a serving or retired government or public sector employee
Not a sitting or former MP or MLA, and not an elected head of a local body
e-KYC must be completed, and the bank account must be in her own name, Aadhaar-seeded and DBT-enabled
documents: Aadhaar card, with a mobile number linked to it for the OTP
NFSA or State Food Security Scheme ration card of the family
Income certificate from the Tahasildar, only if the family holds neither ration card
Bank passbook of an account in her own name, Aadhaar-seeded and DBT-enabled
Residence proof showing an Odisha address
A mobile number she can use to receive the OTP herself

demoFields.label: Aadhaar Number
demoFields.hint: Her own 12 digits. The whole application is built on this number, so check it twice.

demoFields.label: Applicant's Name (as on Aadhaar)
demoFields.hint: Copy it letter for letter from the Aadhaar card. If the bank passbook has a different spelling, get one of them corrected before applying.

demoFields.label: Date of Birth
demoFields.hint: As on Aadhaar. You must be 21 or above and not over 60 on the date fixed for that year's round.

demoFields.label: Mobile Number linked to Aadhaar
demoFields.hint: The e-KYC OTP comes here. If nothing is linked to your Aadhaar, go to a Mo Seva Kendra and do face e-KYC instead.

demoFields.label: Ration Card Type and Number
demoFields.hint: NFSA or SFSS, with the number from the front of the card. If the family has no card, attach the income certificate instead.

demoFields.label: District / Block or ULB / Gram Panchayat / Village
demoFields.hint: Pick from the drop-downs, for the place where you live now.

demoFields.label: Bank Account Number and IFSC (account in her own name)
demoFields.hint: Copy both from your passbook. A joint account or your husband's account will not be paid - the money only goes to an account in your own name.

demoFields.label: Annual Family Income (Rs.)
demoFields.hint: The family's income for one year. It must be Rs 2,50,000 or less if you are applying without a ration card.

demoFields.label: e-KYC
demoFields.value: Completed by OTP on the Aadhaar-linked mobile
demoFields.hint: The application is not counted until e-KYC is done. Face e-KYC at a Mo Seva Kendra is the way round a missing mobile link.

demoFields.label: Declaration
demoFields.value: I am not an income-tax payer, not a government employee, and I do not receive Rs 1,500 a month or more from another scheme
demoFields.hint: Tick it only if it is true. A false declaration means the money is recovered later.

demoSteps: Open the Subhadra portal and press Apply Now, or take your Aadhaar and ration card to a Mo Seva Kendra, Anganwadi centre or CSC. They file it free - do not pay anyone for it.
Enter your Aadhaar and finish e-KYC with the OTP on the Aadhaar-linked mobile. If no mobile is linked, do face e-KYC at a Mo Seva Kendra.
Fill the form, give a bank account in your own name, submit, and note the application number on the acknowledgement.
Ask your bank branch to make the account DBT-enabled, not merely Aadhaar-linked. This one step is behind most of the payments that fail.
Check your name on the beneficiary list on the portal. If you are on the rejected list, the reason is shown next to your name and you can file a grievance on the same site.
Rs 5,000 reaches the account at each instalment, near Rakhi Purnima and near 8 March. Check your passbook or the bank's own message, not a forwarded one.
Ring 14678 between 6 AM and 10 PM for any problem with the application or a missing payment.

schemes.title: Bhulekh Odisha - Land Record (RoR / Khatian)
schemes.department: Revenue & Disaster Management Department, Government of Odisha
schemes.brief: Bhulekh is the state's online land record. You can look up and print the Record of Rights - the khatian - for any plot in Odisha free of charge, with no login. Search by khata number, by plot number, or by the tenant's name. Use it to check who the land stands in the name of and how much area is recorded before you buy, mortgage or divide land. The free printout is for information only; a bank or a court will ask for a certified copy from the Tahasil office.
schemes.benefit: Free view and printout of the Record of Rights for any plot in Odisha
eligibility: Anyone can search - there is no login, no registration and no fee
You need to know the district, the tahasil and the revenue village where the land lies
You can search by khata number, by plot number, or by the tenant's name
The free printout carries no signature; a bank, a court or a registration office needs a certified copy from the Tahasildar
Mutation, partition and correction of a name are not done here - those go through the Tahasil office or Odisha One
documents: Nothing is needed to view the record - no Aadhaar, no login and no fee
The district, tahasil and revenue village (mouza) name of the land
The khata number, the plot number, or the tenant's name as it is written in the record
An older RoR, a rent receipt or the sale deed, to copy those numbers from
Aadhaar and the court fee stamp fixed by the Tahasil office, only if you go on to ask for a certified copy

demoFields.label: District
demoFields.hint: The district where the land lies, not where you live, if the two are different.

demoFields.label: Tahasil
demoFields.hint: Pick from the drop-down. If you do not know the tahasil, the sale deed or an old rent receipt names it.

demoFields.label: Village (Mouza)
demoFields.hint: The revenue village name as it appears in the land record. It is often different from the post office or panchayat name.

demoFields.label: Search by
demoFields.hint: Three choices: khata number, plot number, or tenant's name. Use the plot number if all you have is a sale deed.

demoFields.label: Khatian / Khata Number
demoFields.hint: Copy it from an older RoR, a rent receipt or the deed. One khata can hold several plots.

demoFields.label: Plot Number
demoFields.hint: Fill this box instead if you are searching by plot. Write it exactly, including the part number after the slash.

demoFields.label: Tenant's Name
demoFields.hint: Only if you are searching by name. Spell it as it stands in the record, which may be an old spelling or a father's name form.

demoFields.label: Verification Code (captcha)
demoFields.hint: Type the characters shown in the picture. If you cannot read them, press refresh for a new code.

demoSteps: Open the RoR View page on Bhulekh Odisha and pick your district, tahasil and village from the three drop-downs.
Choose how you want to search - by khata number, by plot number, or by the tenant's name - and fill only that one box.
Type the verification code and press View RoR. The record opens as a PDF showing the khata, the plot numbers, the area and the recorded tenant.
Check the area and the name against your own papers. An ancestor's name still standing on the record means the mutation was never done.
Print or save the PDF. It is free and there is no limit on how many times you look.
For a copy a bank or a court will accept, apply for a certified copy at the Tahasil office or through Odisha One - the free printout carries no signature.
To correct a name or record an inheritance, file a mutation case at the Tahasildar's office. Bhulekh only shows the record; it does not change it.
schemes.helpline: Tahasildar's office of the tahasil where the land lies, or the Revenue Inspector of that circle

schemes.title: Madhu Babu Pension Yojana - Old Age, Widow and Disability Pension
schemes.department: Social Security & Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities Department (SSEPD), Government of Odisha
schemes.brief: Odisha's monthly social security pension. It brought the old Old Age Pension and the state's disability pension together into one scheme, so you will still hear it called by those older names. It pays Rs 500 a month, rising to Rs 700 a month once the pensioner turns 80. Old people aged 60 and above, widows of any age, persons with 40 per cent or more disability, leprosy patients with visible deformity, and AIDS patients and AIDS widows can all apply. The form is filled and submitted at the Block office, or at the NAC or Municipality office in a town. Pension is paid on the 15th of every month.
schemes.benefit: Rs 500 a month, rising to Rs 700 a month from the age of 80
eligibility: Living in Odisha, and aged 60 or above for the old age pension
A widow of any age, a person with 40 per cent or more disability, a leprosy patient with visible deformity, or an AIDS patient or AIDS widow can apply at any age
The family must be poor by the income test the Block applies; an income-tax paying family is not eligible
Not drawing any other government pension, including a service pension or a National Social Assistance Programme pension
Aadhaar, and a bank or post office account in the applicant's own name, are needed for the monthly payment
documents: Aadhaar card of the applicant
Age proof - Aadhaar, voter ID, or a certificate from the medical officer where no document exists
Residence proof showing an Odisha address
Income certificate from the Tahasildar, or the ration card showing the family's category
Death certificate of the husband, for a widow pension
Disability certificate from the Chief District Medical Officer, for a disability pension
First page of the bank or post office passbook, in the applicant's own name
Two passport photographs
schemes.submitAt: Block Development Officer's office of your block if you live in a village, or the Executive Officer of your NAC, Municipality or Corporation if you live in a town. The Gram Panchayat office and Mo Seva Kendras also hand out and take in the form.

demoFields.label: Type of pension applied for
demoFields.value: Old age pension (60 years and above)
demoFields.hint: Tick one only - old age, widow, disability, leprosy or AIDS. You cannot draw two of them together.

demoFields.label: Applicant's Name
demoFields.hint: Exactly as on the Aadhaar card. The pension roll is printed from this name.

demoFields.label: Father's / Husband's Name
demoFields.hint: A widow writes her late husband's name here and attaches his death certificate.

demoFields.label: Date of Birth / Age
demoFields.hint: Take the date from Aadhaar. Where there is no document at all, the medical officer's age certificate is accepted.

demoFields.label: Full Address - District / Block or ULB / Gram Panchayat / Village or Ward
demoFields.hint: The place you actually live. Block staff come to this address to verify, and the pension is paid there.

demoFields.label: Aadhaar Number
demoFields.hint: Your own 12 digits. The pension is stopped if the Aadhaar on the roll does not match the bank account.

demoFields.label: Mobile Number
demoFields.hint: Your own number, or a son's or daughter's number you can reach. Sanction and payment messages go here.

demoFields.label: Bank or Post Office Account Number, Branch and IFSC
demoFields.value: 31554433221100, State Bank of India, Chhatrapur branch, IFSC SBIN0009123
demoFields.hint: Copy all three from the first page of the passbook. The account must be in the pensioner's own name, not a son's.

demoFields.label: Annual Family Income (Rs.)
demoFields.hint: As shown on the income certificate from the Tahasildar. Write the family's income, not only your own.

demoFields.label: Any other pension being drawn
demoFields.hint: Say so honestly. A person already on a service pension or another government pension cannot take this one as well.

demoSteps: Get the printed form from the Block Development Officer's office, the Gram Panchayat office, or the Executive Officer of your NAC or Municipality if you live in a town. Mo Seva Kendras also keep it.

Fill it and attach Aadhaar, age proof, income certificate, the passbook copy and two photographs. A widow adds the husband's death certificate; a disability claim adds the certificate from the Chief District Medical Officer.
Submit the set at the Block office, or at the ULB office in a town, and take the receipt with the case number. Do not leave without it.
The list is read out at the Palli Sabha or the ward meeting, where anyone may object. Be present, because names are added and struck off at that meeting. Block staff then verify your household.
The BDO or the Executive Officer sanctions the pension and your name goes on the block's pension roll.
From the month of sanction, Rs 500 a month - Rs 700 once you are 80 - is paid on the 15th of every month, either at the Panchayat or ward disbursement camp or into your account.
If the pension stops, ask at the Block office first. A pending life certificate or an Aadhaar that is not seeded to the account is almost always the reason.
schemes.helpline: Block Development Officer's office of your block, or the District Social Security Officer at the Collectorate

schemes.title: Biju Pucca Ghar Yojana - Pucca House Grant
schemes.department: Panchayati Raj & Drinking Water Department, Government of Odisha
schemes.brief: The state's own rural housing grant, for poor families in villages who have no pucca house and whose names did not come in the central Pradhan Mantri Awaas Yojana - Gramin list. It replaced the earlier Mo Kudia scheme. The grant is Rs 1,20,000 in plain areas, released in four instalments as the house goes up, with up to 95 days of MGNREGS wage on your job card for building it yourself. The house must stand on land you own or on homestead land given to you by the government. Everything is done at the Gram Panchayat and the Block office.
schemes.benefit: Rs 1,20,000 in four instalments, plus up to 95 days of MGNREGS wage for building the house
eligibility: A family living in rural Odisha with no pucca house of its own, living in a kutcha house or one that has fallen down
The family's name must be in the permanent waiting list kept at the Gram Panchayat; a family already helped under Pradhan Mantri Awaas Yojana - Gramin is not taken again
The family must own the homestead land, or have been given homestead land by the government
A family with a government job, an income-tax payer, or a motorised four-wheeler is left out
Priority goes to families hit by fire, flood or cyclone, and to widows, persons with disability and particularly vulnerable tribal groups
documents: Aadhaar card of the head of the family and of the spouse
MGNREGS job card issued by the Gram Panchayat
First page of the bank passbook of an account in the beneficiary's own name, Aadhaar-seeded
Ration card of the family
Land record (RoR) of the homestead plot, or the government land patta
Photograph of the kutcha house the family lives in now
Caste certificate, where a reserved category is claimed
Death certificate or disability certificate, where priority is claimed on that ground
schemes.submitAt: Gram Panchayat office, with the Panchayat Executive Officer or the Gram Rozgar Sevak, or the Block Development Officer's office of your block

demoFields.label: Name of the Head of the Family
demoFields.hint: As on the Aadhaar card. The grant is sanctioned and paid in this name.

demoFields.label: Spouse's Name
demoFields.hint: The house is normally recorded in the names of both husband and wife, so fill this even if she has no separate papers.

demoFields.label: Aadhaar Numbers of Both
demoFields.hint: Both 12-digit numbers. A wrong digit here stops the instalments later.

demoFields.label: Address - District / Block / Gram Panchayat / Village
demoFields.hint: The village where the house will be built. Block staff photograph the site at this address.

demoFields.label: MGNREGS Job Card Number
demoFields.hint: Copy it from the job card the Gram Panchayat gave you. The wage for the days you work on your own house is paid on this card.

demoFields.label: Present House
demoFields.value: Kutcha, mud walls and thatch roof, two rooms, damaged in the 2025 rains
demoFields.hint: Describe what you live in now, in plain words. The surveyor photographs it, so do not pull it down before the verification.

demoFields.label: Homestead Land
demoFields.value: Khata 84, plot 512, area 0.04 acre, standing in the applicant's own name in the RoR
demoFields.hint: Copy the khata, plot and area from Bhulekh. Without land in your name or a government patta, the case cannot move.

demoFields.label: Bank Account Number and IFSC
demoFields.hint: An account in the beneficiary's own name and Aadhaar-seeded. Every instalment comes only by DBT into this account.

demoFields.label: Ration Card Number and Type
demoFields.hint: Copy it from the front of your card. It is used to check the family against the poverty list.

demoFields.label: Priority Ground Claimed, if any
demoFields.hint: Write fire, flood, cyclone, widow, disability or PVTG if it applies, and attach the proof. It moves your name up the list.

demoSteps: Check at the Gram Panchayat whether your family's name is already on the permanent waiting list. If it is not, ask the Gram Rozgar Sevak or the Panchayat Executive Officer how to have it added.

Fill the application there with their help and attach Aadhaar, the job card, the passbook copy, the ration card and the land record. Submit it at the Gram Panchayat or the Block office and take the receipt with the case number.
Attend the Palli Sabha where the list is read out. Names are added and struck off at that meeting, so be there in person.
Block staff come and verify the family and photograph the kutcha house. Leave the old house standing until this is done.
On sanction, Rs 1,20,000 comes in four instalments - on sanction, at plinth level, at lintel level, and on completion. Each one is released only after that stage is photographed and geo-tagged.
Do the building work under MGNREGS on your own job card. Up to 95 days of unskilled wage is paid on top of the grant.
If an instalment does not come, ask the Block office which stage photograph is missing. That is nearly always the reason.
schemes.helpline: Panchayat Executive Officer or Gram Rozgar Sevak at your Gram Panchayat, or the Block Development Officer's office

schemes.title: OPSC Recruitment - Applying on OPSC Chayan
schemes.brief: Every Odisha Public Service Commission recruitment is applied for on one portal, OPSC Chayan. It covers the Odisha Civil Services examination and posts such as Assistant Executive Engineer, Assistant Agriculture Engineer, Assistant Horticulture Officer, Assistant Fisheries Officer, Assistant Public Prosecutor, Veterinary Assistant Surgeon, Medical Officer and Assistant Professor. The Commission's own website carries the advertisements, the syllabus, the results and the old question papers, but no application is made there. The portal is in English only.
schemes.benefit: Entry to a Group A or Group B government post in Odisha
eligibility: Each advertisement fixes its own qualification, age and experience - read that advertisement before you pay anything
The minimum age for most posts is 21, counted as on the date printed in the advertisement
Upper age relaxation of 5 years for SC, ST, SEBC and women candidates, and 10 years for persons with benchmark disability, as the advertisement states
You must be able to read, write and speak Odia, checked in the way the advertisement lays down
An email address and a mobile number of your own, both verified by OTP, are needed to open the candidate account
documents: Matriculation certificate, which is the only proof of date of birth the Commission accepts
Degree or diploma certificate and all mark sheets of the qualifying examination
Caste certificate in the Odisha format, for SC, ST or SEBC
Residence or nativity certificate of Odisha
Disability certificate, for a person with benchmark disability
Recent passport photograph and a signature in black ink on white paper, scanned to the size the portal states
No Objection Certificate from the employer, if you are already in government service
Experience certificates, where the post asks for experience

demoFields.label: Advertisement Number and Post
demoFields.hint: Copy it from the advertisement on the OPSC website. One application per advertisement - a second one is rejected.

demoFields.label: Candidate's Name
demoFields.hint: Exactly as on your matriculation certificate, letter for letter. A mismatch here is the commonest reason for being struck off at document verification.

demoFields.label: Father's Name / Mother's Name
demoFields.hint: Both as spelt on the matriculation certificate.

demoFields.label: Date of Birth
demoFields.hint: From the matriculation certificate only. No other age proof is taken, whatever your Aadhaar says.

demoFields.label: Email ID and Mobile Number
demoFields.hint: Both get an OTP at registration. Use your own and keep them for the whole recruitment - the admit card and interview call come here.

demoFields.label: Category
demoFields.hint: General, SC, ST, SEBC, EWS or PwD. Claim it only if you hold the certificate in the Odisha format. It cannot be changed after the edit window shuts.

demoFields.label: Educational Qualification
demoFields.hint: The degree the post asks for, with the university, the year of passing and the marks as printed on the mark sheet.

demoFields.label: Permanent Address
demoFields.value: At Balipatna, PO Kandarpur, Salepur, Cuttack - 754202
demoFields.hint: The address on your residence certificate. Post from the Commission is sent here.

demoFields.label: Photograph and Signature Upload
demoFields.value: Passport photograph on a plain background, signature in black ink on white paper
demoFields.hint: Follow the exact pixel size and file size shown on the page. A photo with a busy background or a signature in capitals is rejected.

demoFields.label: Examination Fee
demoFields.value: Paid online before the last date; the amount and the exempted categories are printed in the advertisement
demoFields.hint: An application whose fee has not gone through is not an application at all. Keep the payment receipt.

demoSteps: Read the advertisement on the OPSC website, check the qualification and your age as on the date it fixes, and note the last date and the fee.
Open OPSC Chayan, register with your email and mobile, verify both OTPs, and write down the User ID the portal gives you.
Fill the application, upload the photograph, signature and certificates in the sizes shown, and pay the fee online if your category has to pay.
Submit and download the PDF of the submitted application. It carries the application number you will need for every query afterwards.
Use the edit window the Commission opens after the last date to correct any mistake. Once it closes, nothing can be changed.
Download the admit card from Chayan when it is released and carry a printed copy with a photo ID to the examination centre.
If you are called for document verification or interview, take the originals of everything you claimed. A claim you cannot prove on paper is struck off.
schemes.helpline: Odisha Public Service Commission office, Cuttack - the contact numbers are printed in each advertisement
